responsibility: Implements the call_details adapter that presents one GIMPLE call site to known-function models and other call handlers. It resolves the call’s lhs region and type, exposes argument trees and symbolic values through the region_model, provides convenience access to string literals, logging, uncertainty, and fndecl lookup, and can conjure call-result svalues while purging related stale state.
same_name_distinction: Implements the call_details methods that derive per-call facts from a gcall plus region_model, such as lhs resolution, argument/value access, string-literal extraction, dumping, and conjured return values. Unlike call-details.h, it contains the operational adapter logic.
